meta.name: version-bump
meta.description: Automated semantic versioning and release workflow for Claude Code plugins. Handles version increments across package.json, marketplace.json, plugin.json manifests, build verification, git tagging, GitHub releases, and changelog generation. NPM publishing is the final human-required handoff because the maintainer raised npm security.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动完成版本号递增、构建校验、git 标签与发布说明生成
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次发版都要手动改版本号、打标签、写发布说明。
copy.tagline_en: Automate version bumps, build checks, git tags, and changelog generation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if every release means manually editing versions, tagging, and writing release notes.

howto.what: 按语义化版本判断 PATCH/MINOR/MAJOR,同步更新八个配置文件的版本号,再构建、提交、打 git tag、推送、建 GitHub release 并重新生成 CHANGELOG;最后一步 npm 发布留给你手动执行。
howto.when: 当你需要给这套 Claude Code 插件发布新版本、改动版本号或走一遍发布流程时接手。它不自行执行 npm 发布,那一步交还给你。

say.text: 把这个插件的版本升到 1.2.0 并走完发布流程
这次是修 bug,按 patch 升一个版本发布
say.note: 按 PATCH 递增版本号

say.text: 重新生成 CHANGELOG 并提交推送
say.note: 从 GitHub API 拉取 release 重写并推送

howto.what_en: Judges PATCH/MINOR/MAJOR, updates the version string in all eight config files, then builds, commits, tags, pushes, creates a GitHub release and regenerates the CHANGELOG; npm publish is left for you to run by hand.
howto.when_en: Use it when you want to release a new version of this Claude Code plugin, change its version number, or run the release flow. It never runs npm publish itself — that step is handed back to you.

say_en.text: Bump this plugin to 1.2.0 and run the whole release flow
say_en.note: Updates eight files, tags, creates a GitHub release

say_en.text: This was a bug fix, bump a patch version and release
Regenerate the CHANGELOG and push it
say_en.note: Pulls releases from the GitHub API and pushes
